text: Night Sakura and the Dancing Sword
The monsters seem to be heading to the top of the waterfall.\nBlock them from progressing with Tenert and the others while\nSherry goes to there to check it out!
The monsters seem to be gathering because of the ghastly\naura released by Caylass' sword, the Scarlet Sakura. Go get\nthe drunk and grumbling Scarlet Sakura and take it home!
